entries.title: Hosea 12:1
segments: ¶"Ephraim feeds on the wind, And pursues the east wind; He daily increases lies and desolation. Also they make a covenant with the Assyrians, And oil is carried to Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 12:2
segments: "The LORD also [brings] a charge against Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways; According to his deeds He will recompense him.

entries.title: Hosea 12:3
segments: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, And in his strength he struggled with God.

entries.title: Hosea 12:4
segments: Yes, he struggled with the Angel and prevailed; He wept, and sought favor from Him. He found Him [in] Bethel, And there He spoke to us-

entries.title: Hosea 12:5
segments: That is, the LORD God of hosts. The LORD [is] His memorable name.

entries.title: Hosea 12:6
segments: So you, by [the help of] your God, return; Observe mercy and justice, And wait on your God continually.

entries.title: Hosea 12:7
segments: ¶"A cunning Canaanite! Deceitful scales [are] in his hand; He loves to oppress.

entries.title: Hosea 12:8
segments: And Ephraim said, 'Surely I have become rich, I have found wealth for myself; [In] all my labors They shall find in me no iniquity that [is] sin.'

entries.title: Hosea 12:9
segments: "But I [am] the LORD your God, Ever since the land of Egypt; I will again make you dwell in tents, As in the days of the appointed feast.

entries.title: Hosea 12:10
segments: I have also spoken by the prophets, And have multiplied visions; I have given symbols through the witness of the prophets."

entries.title: Hosea 12:11
segments: Though Gilead [has] idols-Surely they are vanity-Though they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal, Indeed their altars [shall be] heaps in the furrows of the field.

entries.title: Hosea 12:12
segments: Jacob fled to the country of Syria; Israel served for a spouse, And for a wife he tended [sheep].

entries.title: Hosea 12:13
segments: By a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, And by a prophet he was preserved.

entries.title: Hosea 12:14
segments: Ephraim provoked [Him] to anger most bitterly; Therefore his Lord will leave the guilt of his bloodshed upon him, And return his reproach upon him.
